newsitem.title: FRANCE: Schneider in Spie MBO, Amec talks.
newsitem.headline: Schneider in Spie MBO, Amec talks.

text.p: French electrical engineering company Schneider said on Monday it was in negotiations for a management buy-out (MBO) of its Spie Batignolles construction subsidiary, part of which it hopes to sell to Amec Plc.
"There is in fact a management buy-out plan being discussed. But I remain cautious as the negotiations with the employees and Amec have not finished," a Spie spokeswoman told Reuters.

The Spie sale, expected to be for around one billion francs, is expected to leave Amec with between 40 and 49 percent of Spie, with the management group owning the rest through a holding company, Financiere Spie Batignolles.
Schneider shares were up 2.7 percent at 254.70 francs at 1533 GMT.
The market is hoping the sale can be agreed by December 15, brokers said.
